pages.preference.statistics.heatmapUnava: Update the Statistics plugin to show the keyboard heatmap.
pages.preference.statistics.heatmapHint: Darker keys mean more presses. Hover for counts. Only unordered per-key totals are stored; older history has no per-key counts. Some keys are grouped by the platform.
pages.preference.statistics.heatmapUnava: Update the Statistics plugin to show the keyboard heatmap.
pages.preference.statistics.heatmapHint: Darker keys mean more presses. Hover for counts. Only unordered per-key totals are stored; older history has no per-key counts. Some keys are grouped by the platform.
pages.preference.statistics.resetConfirm: Clear all input counts, charts and application time history? This cannot be undone. Settings are kept. Han counts, character frequencies and session typing speeds are also cleared.
pages.preference.statistics.resetUnavail: Update the Statistics plugin to enable reset.
pages.preference.statistics.title: Statistics
pages.preference.statistics.description: Input counts, application time, daily/hourly charts, local storage and CSV export. Disabling keeps history.
pages.preference.statistics.privacy: Local input totals, app names/durations and Han character frequencies. No sentences, input order, coordinates, window titles, URLs or screenshots are stored.
pages.preference.statistics.inactive: Install or enable the Statistics plugin on the Plugins page to start counting.
pages.preference.statistics.storageError: Statistics could not be saved. Check disk space and data directory permissions.
pages.preference.statistics.activity: Bar height: key presses + mouse clicks
pages.preference.statistics.unitsHint: Movement uses desktop pixels/points, or raw device units with Linux evdev. Wheel units vary by device; neither value is a physical distance.
pages.preference.statistics.exported: CSV saved in the data folder
pages.preference.statistics.usageHint: Samples the foreground app every second. Pauses after 5 idle minutes, during screen lock and across sleep. App names and durations stay local.
pages.preference.statistics.usageUnavail: Foreground app tracking is unavailable in this desktop session. Wayland is unsupported; X11 requires xcb and xcb-screensaver.
pages.preference.statistics.usageEmpty: No application usage recorded for this period yet.
native.statisticsUnitHint: Display = raw value 脳 multiplier. Labels: up to 16 characters; empty uses the language default. Only this page changes; history, CSV and the floating panel keep raw units.
native.statisticsUnitSaveFailed: Unable to save units. Use up to 16 characters per label and a multiplier between 0.000000001 and 1000000000.
pages.preference.statistics.wordsEmpty: No Han character commits recorded in this period.
pages.preference.statistics.wordsUnavail: Update the Statistics plugin to display character statistics.
pages.preference.statistics.wordsUnsuppo: Character collection requires Windows UI Automation.
pages.preference.statistics.wordsCoverag: Collecting Han input. Compatibility mode detects candidates confirmed with Space, Enter or number keys. App accessibility support determines coverage.
pages.preference.statistics.wordsFailed: UI Automation could not start. Character collection is unavailable.
pages.preference.statistics.wordsLost: Some input events could not be collected. These totals may be incomplete.
pages.preference.statistics.wordsSpeedHi: Speeds use this session, independent of the selected period. Average = Han characters / active minutes: each burst starts with one second; commit gaps over five seconds start a new burst. Punctuation, Latin letters and pasted text are excluded. Han characters from other languages may count.
pages.preference.statistics.timerHint: Session timer: enabling starts/resumes; disabling pauses. The five seconds after each captured Han commit count as typing; all other enabled time counts as idle, including unobserved input. Restart clears the timer; Reset statistics clears its times and keeps its switch.
pages.preference.statistics.subtractBack: Subtract Han characters deleted with Backspace

Off by default; saved across restarts. Only subtracts observed, counted characters in the current input. Switching focus, shortcuts or mouse clicks stop tracking. Pinyin edits, pasted and older text are excluded. Totals, frequencies and speeds change; typing time does not.
